behavior: The pay page shows the invoice's PO number or reference, so the client's accounts team can match it
acceptance: When an invoice has a reference (R-90), the pay page shows 'Reference <PO>' as a quiet row with an icon above the due date, with the invoice's other terms; without one there is no row.
A 100-character reference wraps on a 390 px phone without sideways scrolling; the pay page has no serious or critical axe violations in either theme with the row shown.
notes: 2026-10-17 review pass by reviewer: PASS. Row shows 'Reference <PO>' above Due with the other quiet rows, only when invoice.reference is set (checked by hand: reference null gives no row); icon aria-hidden, same ICON/text-muted/gap as Due and Closes in; copy matches the PDF ('Reference <ref>'); R-90 row and DESIGN.md match. max-w-full on the ul is needed (items-start parent sizes it to the unbroken word) and works: a 100-char no-space reference wraps at 390 and 1440 px with no sideways scroll. pay.spec 19/19, vitest 87/87, lint, typecheck, docs-check pass. Clock fix is the right root cause: without page.clock the OPEN fixture (expiresAt 2026-10-17T15:00Z) reads as closed today (0 Show address buttons, 'This invoice is closed'); with NOW it is open, same as openPay. No other time bomb found: every other pay.spec test uses openPay or installs NOW, privy e2e fixtures are relative to Date.now() (fixed dates there are past, display only), unit tests pass now explicitly or use setSystemTime, kit date picker starts from a fixed value. Minor notes: (1) pay-invoice.tsx:284 items-center puts the icon beside the middle line when a long reference wraps, and the browser breaks after 'PO-'; items-start would keep it on line 1. (2) pay.spec.ts:701 only checks no sideways scroll, not that the full reference is visible, so a later truncate would still pass. (3) pay-invoice.tsx:282 comment mostly restates R-90. (4) pay.spec.ts:47 'as string | null' is unused. (5) New invoice Preview (new-invoice-preview.tsx:21, 'reading order of the pay page') does not show the reference; not in F219 scope, possible follow-up.

proof.1: e2e: pay.spec 'shows who asks and the amount…' finds 'Reference PO-4500012345' on the pay page of an invoice with a reference; the code renders the row only when invoice.reference is set (pay-invoice.tsx Terms)
proof.2: e2e: pay.spec 'fits a 390 px phone…' opens an invoice with a 100-character reference without spaces and finds no sideways scroll; the axe tests in the light and dark themes open OPEN, which now carries a reference, with no serious or critical violations
